hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */web/src/*.ts|*/web/src/*.tsx) cd "${f%%/web/src/*}/web" || exit 0; pnpm exec prettier --write --log-level warn "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; out=$(pnpm exec eslint --fix "$f" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; */web/src/*.css) cd "${f%%/web/src/*}/web" || exit 0; pnpm exec prettier --write --log-level warn "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0; }
hooks.statusMessage: web のファイルを整形・lint しています
